_comment: 8d Phase B2 (issue #14): the trap gauntlet, the SKILL pillar's showcase map -- identity is TRAPS, not monsters. Four trap classes as DATA PROPS on existing machinery (no new sim): pressure_plate_a (plain on_interact_accomplishment/toast trigger + the generic ANY-entity observe fallback reveal -- no requires_skill needed), dart_slit_a and illusory_floor_a (both requires_skill:'observe' + on_skill_use -- the DISARM-ONLY shape: a dash-through timing window was traced and does not exist anywhere in this sim [no field-movement timing/i-frame mechanism, combat's own Dash is a separate AP-economy system], so per the icy_floor escalate-don't-force-fit lesson this ships disarm-only, not flagged as a gap), snare_nest_slot (a trigger_radius ENCOUNTER SLOT, placement-only prop per the rift_vermin_leak D1 precedent -- no combat data, C-phase promotes). Biome `dungeon`. Connects to dungeon_approach via a real new door pair (dungeon_approach_return); UNREACHABLE from any EXISTING live map this phase, `dungeon_peek` teleports in. Grid-bound clipping stops movement at the edge (no perimeter walls); one interior rubble-column segment for texture.

segments._comment: A collapsed rubble column, interior texture only -- clear of every entity/decor/blocked cell.

floor_layers._pick: Cemetery-floor variation reusing the dungeon biome's own verified floor-tile neighborhood (2,2)/(3,7) plus the genuinely darker worn variant (2,11) for real wear texture.

entities._comment: Return leg of the new dungeon_approach<->trapped_halls door pair. to_cell (13,6) sits one cell west of dungeon_depths_door's own (14,6) cell (the sewer_exit/deep_fissure 'never land on the door's own cell' convention).

TRAP CLASS 1: pressure plate. Plain prop shape -- on_interact_accomplishment/toast fires the TRIGGER on any plain E-interact (no skill gate; a real player can blunder into it), the generic ANY-entity `observe` fallback ([Appraise Foe], no requires_skill needed) is the REVEAL. visual_states swaps to a warning tint once triggered (live re-render, ACCOMPLISHMENT_RECORDED).
entities.observe: One flagstone sits a hair proud of its neighbors, the mortar cracked clean around its edge. Stepping square on it feels like a very bad idea.
entities.toast: The flagstone gives half an inch under your hand. Somewhere close, something CLICKS. Nothing else happens. This time.

entities._comment: 8d C1/C4 (issue #14): the TALK route -- Ksmvr, standing beside the plate (7,7), a second sighting of the same character now placed at dungeon_approach (the vault_boss_slot/dormant_guardian_marker 'closer sighting' idiom applied to an ally instead of the boss). Own graph (ksmvr_plates.json): the guide option is the real beat, gated on `horns_party_formed` (the party must exist to guide) -- see that file's own _comment for the full node walk.

TRAP CLASS 2: dart line. DISARM-ONLY shape (see map _comment for the traced dash-through-window verdict). requires_skill:'observe' + on_skill_use is the real disarm (field-hotbar [Appraise Foe] faced at this entity). A plain E-interact with the skill KNOWN reads the 2026-07-10 nudge ruling (skill_hint_toast, never auto-disarms); with the skill UNKNOWN it falls to use_skill()'s skill_unknown + locked_toast refusal (already covered generically elsewhere in the QA corpus -- barracks_walkthrough/upstairs_walkthrough/wrong_order_loop/work_loop). Placeholder art: A3's own pixellab dart_slit.png candidate drifted purple against the Cemetery family's olive-warm-grey palette (A3's own flagged concern, unretuned) -- NOT integrated; reuses the registered `sewer_grate` sprite (a wall-vent silhouette, thematically apt) tinted cool-dark. Flagged for the controller's art pass: regen dart_slit against this real floor family. 8d C1 (issue #14) SKILL route wiring: `requires_item: 'trap_kit'` (use_skill()'s new item-possession gate, the archery_butt precedent's twin) is the real coin cost -- skill known + trap_kit NOT carried nudges `item_hint_toast` (never auto-refuses to a locked_toast, the skill genuinely IS known); trap_kit carried consumes it (`on_skill_use.remove_item`, the hungry-patron `remove_item` verb's use_skill() twin) and banks `halls_cleared` DIRECTLY as the disarm's own accomplishment (the price_of_a_favor `hollow_true_knot` precedent -- an on_skill_use prop banking the SHARED convergence counter itself, no separate report needed; disarming THIS specific trap and 'the halls are clear' are the same beat, so the old flavor-only `disarmed_dart_line` id is retired, never referenced anywhere else).
entities.skill_hint_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. This wants a careful, deliberate touch, not a shove.
entities.locked_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height. Whatever is loaded behind it, you have no idea how to disable it.
entities.item_hint_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. Bare hands won't do it -- you'd want a proper kit for this.

on_skill_use.toast: You trace the mechanism with a careful eye, find the catch, and wedge it still with a wax-and-wire pick from the kit. The slit stays dark.

entities._comment: TRAP CLASS 3: illusory floor. VERIFIED the existing visual_states seam covers 'floor that isn't' -- no new sim needed: this is a plain kind:prop entity, and any entity's occupied cell already blocks movement (is_cell_blocked's occupancy check, src/core/wi_game.gd) regardless of `blocked`/`kind` -- so a player who tries to walk straight across gets a real PLAYER_BLOCKED bump, exactly the 'the floor visibly continues but something refuses to let you cross' read, zero new mechanism. requires_skill:'observe' + on_skill_use is the reveal (a bespoke per-prop accomplishment, not the shared observed_things counter); visual_states swaps to a warning tint once spotted. Placeholder art: A3's own pixellab illusory_floor.png candidate was already flagged 'too uniform' at A3 AND drifts navy-blue against the Cemetery family (unretuned, same palette-drift class as dart_slit) -- NOT integrated; substituted with a same-PACK Cemetery Props.png debris crop (guaranteed palette match, see sprites.json's illusory_floor_tell entry for the full rationale) tinted toward this map's floor. Flagged for the controller's art pass: regen illusory_floor against this real floor family, retuned shimmer edge per A3's own note. MOUSE TELL-LEAK (v1, accepted): #57 click-to-walk paths AROUND entity cells, so a mouse player sees the path bend before any [Observe] -- the keyboard bump read is the primary experience; no cheap fix without breaking the pathfinder's move_player-parity invariant.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The floor ahead looks exactly like the floor behind you. Somehow, that is the part that bothers you.
entities.locked_toast: The floor ahead looks perfectly ordinary. Something about it still itches at the back of your mind.

on_skill_use.toast: You look again, and this time you see it: the grain runs the wrong way, and no dust has settled in months. That is not floor. That is a very good painting of floor.

entities._comment: TRAP CLASS 4: snare, PROMOTED to a live encounter (8d C1, issue #14) -- the FIGHT route's real cost, HP not coin. Roster: `snare_ward_a`/`snare_ward_b` ('Lesser Ward' constructs -- stat clones of ruin_ward_a/b with plain melee ai; see snare_ward_a's combatants.json _comment for why a separate id exists: ruin_ward's issue-#83 `guard` profile has no boss to escort HERE, so guard wards clustered instead of engaging and eroded this fight to 0.94, the same illusory-cost failure fixed below once already) + `rift_vermin_c` ('Ember-Touched Vermin', the flame_bolt caster -- Magical Rats are drawn to leaking ambient magic per that combatant's own wiki cite, and vermin nesting behind a snare IS this entity's 'something in the dark past it' flavor) -- no invented species, no stat changes (the 8d C1 review's roster-only ruling: the original 2-ward roster measured 0.99/2r at the T4 build, an illusory cost; this roster measures 0.69/3r, GATED 0.55-0.95/3-12 in sim_combat_batch.gd's DUNGEON_CELLS). Own arena `trapped_halls_snare` (data/arenas.json, 4 enemy_spawns -- the 3-enemy roster hit the enemy-side spawn-ceiling trap at the original 2). Solo (no allies -- the party hasn't formed a fighting line here, this is the player's own trap to spring). INTERACT-ONLY, no trigger_radius: the vault-approach route passes within Chebyshev 2 of this cell regardless of which pillar the player chose, so a proximity trigger would force EVERY route through this fight -- interact-only keeps FIGHT a genuine choice, the rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian precedent. `encounter_when` gated on `horns_delve_started` -- dormant/inert (gate_closed_toast reuses the pre-promotion flavor toast verbatim) until the quest is actually accepted, so `dungeon_peek`'s teleport-only probe still walks past it inert. on_victory banks `halls_cleared` DIRECTLY (the SAME shared convergence counter the SKILL/TALK routes bank -- any producer opens the vault's own `encounter_when` gate, which ALSO requires the party formed).
entities.observe: A coil of taut wire lies strung ankle-height between two stones, near-invisible against the dust. Whatever it is rigged to is worse than a stubbed toe.
entities.gate_closed_toast: You give the wire a wide berth. Something in the dark past it has not noticed you yet.

entities._comment: 8d C1 (issue #14/#82): THE VAULT, PROMOTED to a live encounter. Arena `vault` (12x8, >= 4 player_spawns -- the C2 review's SPAWN-CEILING TRAP, exactly consumed by the 4-body pc+ceria+yvlon+ksmvr roster below), enemies `vault_construct` (tuned, gains `slam`, sim_combat_batch.gd's PARTY_CELLS `vault_construct_t4_party` GATED 0.55-0.95/3-12-round band). `ally_requires: {horns_party_formed: 1}` -- Ceria's OWN recruit-conversation counter (dungeon_approach), not the bare accept counter `horns_delve_started` her earlier C3-authored placeholder comment floated: the roster should field only once the party has genuinely formed, mirroring `relc_descent`'s `met_relc`-adjacent precedent (a real recruit beat, not merely 'quest started'). `ally_hp_penalty.ksmvr` is the TALK route's real cost (8d C4): gated on `guided_ksmvr_through_plates` (banked only by `ksmvr_plates.json`'s guide option, trapped_halls), it reduces Ksmvr's `hp_mod` by 18 (con15 -> base max_hp 35, enters this fight at 17) -- reuses the GENERIC `hp_mod` field wi_combat.gd already reads off every combatant cfg (well_fed's own +2 precedent), zero new sim mechanism. `encounter_when: {requires: {halls_cleared: 1, horns_party_formed: 1}}` is BOTH the trap-gauntlet gate AND the solo-lockout (`_encounter_gate_met`'s 'requires' shape, two keys ANDed): without the party leg, a player who accepted the quest, walked PAST Ceria, and cleared the halls via FIGHT/SKILL could interact here and `start_combat`'s unmet ally_requires would silently EMPTY the ally list -- a solo fight against a boss tuned 0.55-0.95 for a 4-body party, no refusal, no signpost. The party leg refuses that interact instead; the gate_closed_toast below signposts BOTH legs diegetically (halls + Horns) since one toast serves every unmet combination. INTERACT-ONLY, no trigger_radius (a build-time reversal of the snare_nest_slot precedent this entity's own earlier comment floated): a proximity trigger at radius 2 fires the instant the player's approach cell (17,6) comes within Chebyshev 2 of (18,6) -- discovered live, it collapses the deliberate 'step up and choose to engage' threshold-crossing read into an unavoidable ambush, and every approach vector this map's own geometry allows sits inside that radius anyway. Matches rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian/awakened_boss's own interact-only convention for a boss the player consciously commits to, not an environmental ambush. on_victory banks `vault_construct_downed`; the deeper `seal_kept_door` FIND prop (below) reads it.
entities.observe: The hall ends in a sealed archway, and beyond it something vast fills the dark almost completely -- the same shape you glimpsed crouched near the entrance, closer now, utterly still. It is not still the way a statue is still.
entities.gate_closed_toast: Whatever waits beyond this arch, you are not walking into it yet — not with the halls still armed, not without the Horns at your back.

entities._comment: 8d C1 (issue #14): the FIND beat -- the deeper rune-door, past where the construct fell. Plain interact-reveal prop with a GATED `variants` override (the new on_interact_accomplishment reuse of `_resolve_skill_use_effect`): the base (default) reading is a harmless pre-victory flavor line (this cell is reachable by walking row 7 around vault_boss_slot's own occupied cell, so a sequence-break must read as inert, not a spoiler); the variant, gated on `vault_construct_downed`, is the real find -- banks `seal_kept_found` with the BINDING toast verbatim. Placed at (19,7), approached from (18,7) facing right -- clear of vault_boss_slot's own (18,6) cell.
entities.toast: The passage doesn't end here -- it just goes quiet, past a bend the light doesn't reach. Whatever's back there, this isn't the moment.

variants.toast: The runes are the same. Not similar — the same hand, the same order, as the door in the inn's pantry.
